title: Christmas Cake
description: A super-simple festive fruit cake using chocolate milk to soak the dried fruit and create a rich, heady sponge. Needs at least 12 hours soaking time.

ingredients.text: 530g mixed dried fruit (peel, glacé cherries, sultanas, raisins, cranberries)

steps: Start at least 12 hours before eating. Put the dried fruit and chocolate milk in a bowl, cover in cling film and leave to soak so the fruits absorb the liquid and become plump and juicy.
Preheat the oven to 180°C/160°C fan. Grease and line a 23cm round cake tin.
When the fruit is ready, sift in the flour and stir until fully combined.
Pour into the tin, bang on a table a couple of times to get rid of air bubbles, and smooth the top.
Bake for around 2 hours, or until a skewer inserted into the middle comes out clean.
Allow to cool in the tin before turning out on to a wire rack.
notes: Serves 12. Keeps for a couple of weeks in a sealed tin. Try other flavours of milk or orange juice for a lighter sponge.
